lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Open a populated map and wait until MapLibre renders it
Open and close layer properties and project settings at least five times
Send the application to background and return, then lock and unlock the screen
Recreate MainActivity by switching a Collector project or changing configuration
Load or switch to a large Collector project without touching the map and wait for project styling to finish
On Android 9 leave the styled map untouched for at least ten minutes, then repeat background and screen-lock cycles and inspect renderer-mode logs
During Activity recreation touch the old map surface and verify late events are ignored
Inspect HyperLog lifecycle, first-frame-after-resume and render-recovery entries
value.expected: The map becomes visible after project styling without requiring a pan gesture and remains rendered and interactive after every return while Android controls stay responsive and are never covered by a full-window black surface; every API logs SurfaceViewMapRenderer, Android 8-9 log tilePrefetch=false without a 5/30 FPS cap or idle CONTINUOUS mode, remains responsive after low-memory pressure, each created MapView has balanced start/stop and one destroy, late touches do not query a destroyed map, and bounded render recovery never reports completion while fully=false or loadingForeground=true and clears only a stale loading foreground without restarting the process. Every API restores the previous rendering mode after the burst.
